skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 3-hit combo to a single target for 35% ATK (+3) damage.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all enemies for 17% ATK (+2) damage. If self is in the [Berserk] state, restore HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all enemies for 17% ATK (+2) damage, and directly restores own HP. At the same time, attacks from surrounding allies ignore 20% DEF for a duration.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After acting, grants the ally with the lowest HP percentage (including self) [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 25% of own max HP).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After acting, grants the ally with the lowest HP percentage (excluding self) [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 25% of own max HP), and has a 50% chance to grant self [Tenacity].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After acting, grants the ally with the lowest HP percentage (excluding self) [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 35% of own max HP), and has a 50% chance to grant self [Tenacity].

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
